theorems.name: Submission.classical_tangent_off_plane_mass_decay
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (ε : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → V.IsApproxTangentAt x P → 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * V.weight.real (closedBall x ρ \ {y | infDist (y - x) (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) < ε * ρ})) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
